label: Voluntary acceptance of relationship: Accepts records a person’s accepting the proposed relationship
definition: Accepts records a person’s accepting the proposed relationship. It is not identified with believing God exists, nor is its negation identified with causal resistance responsible for nonbelief. The finite believer-with-refusal witness defeats a logical implication from belief alone, not every motivation-based objection.
